DAT stores scalar count/height and 24 bytes per glyph; CVTSI2SS/MULSS/CVTTSS2SI scaling, signed16 height and unsigned16 metrics, first duplicate wins, required 0091 fallback. Special scalar records project space/LF advance, 0091 fallback fields and zero CR; native resource fields/padding omitted. Image sources retain reset wrapper clones sharing backing; DAT consumes supplied cursor. Per-glyph resources alias the two image owners. Installed native search rules and priority300 FileStore supplied all three resources (3 cache opens, 0 physical opens); glyph draw and retained texture recreation passed. Physical-path compatibility API delegates to same loader. Host priming/transactional failures/shared ownership differ native preload policy, reload, unchecked partial state and full VFS/allocator ABI. docs/MOUNTED_RESOURCE_STREAMS.md and docs/FONT_RESOURCE_OWNERSHIP.md.
